description: This file defines an interface for monitoring receiver performance metrics in Orleans streaming providers, including methods for tracking initialization, read attempts, message reception, and shutdown events.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring receiver performance metrics in Orleans streaming providers.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks attempts to initialize the receiver, recording success status, call duration, and exceptions if any.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks attempts to read from the partition, recording success status, call duration, and exceptions if any.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Tracks messages received and time taken per successful read, including message count and enqueue times.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks attempts to shutdown the receiver, recording success status, call duration, and exceptions if any.
